annotations.title: Update a map from a sequencing consensus

description: Write the differences a whole-plasmid sequencing consensus shows into the map, keeping the map's annotation: every feature is shifted, grown or shrunk with the edit, a feature whose boundary an edit cuts is trimmed (and named), and differences in a known nanopore error context (Dam/Dcm methylation sites, long homopolymers) are left out unless keepArtifacts is set. Returns the updated map as a GenBank record and as SnapGene .dna bytes (base64), plus a change log. Use it when the clone is what you want and the MAP is out of date — a change every clone carries, a redesigned primer, a different allele — not to absorb one clone's mutation. `positions` limits the update to those design positions (e.g. only the changes shared by every clone).

circular.description: Treat both as circular (right for a plasmid).

consensus.description: The assembled consensus from the sequencing service, raw or FASTA. One record.

design.description: The map to update: your annotated GenBank record (what keeps the features), FASTA or bare bases.

keepArtifacts.description: Also write differences that sit in a known nanopore error context. Off by default: those are usually read-out artifacts, and writing one into the map makes it wrong.

positions.description: Write only the differences at these design positions (1-based). Omitted: every difference.

name: map_update_from_consensus
title: Update a map from a sequencing consensus
